purpose: Checks whether the held-out 10 ICs' skew toward smoother, higher-energy waveforms (see ic_representativeness.json) correlates with FNO error, which would indicate the skew is biasing M3's headline error numbers.
interpretation: All correlations are weak (|r| <= 0.15, n=10), so the representativeness skew found in ic_representativeness.json does not show a clear relationship with error in this data - no evidence it is systematically biasing the headline error results in either direction. With only 10 points these correlation estimates are noisy, not a statistically definitive test.
